scientific_integrity: Complete analytic proof is provided with normalization and domain. Numerical checks corroborate but do not certify infinite quantifiers. The Euclidean p=2 portion is known through prior work and is not claimed separately as original.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to coordinate product circles, at least two factors, finite exponents, and fixed positive damping; independent validation and exhaustive literature uniqueness are not established.
title: Sharp norm transition for intrinsic Laplace covariance on products of circles
